plans.name: Stream homestead
plans.goal: Make the stream homestead a dependable place to eat, sleep and store supplies.
plans.why: A working home and renewable food give me a base for sharing crops and helping build the settlement.
plans.done_when: A wheat harvest has been replanted, at least twenty watered crop tiles are established, and I have slept in a bed in the lit cabin with a working door and storage. The field and stair approach are marked.
plans.needs: Use the shared white bed at night. Gary and Margo both set their respawn here. The sun stayed in the east during repeated checks, and the bed did not allow sleep.

steps.text: Harvest and replant ripe stream wheat to grow the seed supply.
steps.note: Harvested and replanted one confirmed mature wheat, gaining two seeds.

steps.text: Plant at least twenty crops by water.
steps.note: Verified at least 21 watered crop tiles. Added a waterlogged birch slab to the east strip and saw the previously pale soil beside it turn dark.

steps.text: Make and place a bed in the cabin, then sleep in it.
steps.note: White bed placed. Gary and Margo set their respawn here. Repeated daylight checks never allowed actual sleep. Try the bed after dusk.

steps.text: Check the cabin shell and door, light the interior, and add a chest.
steps.note: Patched walls and roof, closed working door, and verified torches and chest.

steps.text: Save the finished homestead markers and put away supplies.
steps.note: Cabin and field signs, shared composter, and a lit cobblestone stair route are in place.

history.name: Cabin repair
history.goal: Restore the cabin so I can shut the door and sleep safely.

steps.text: Gather birch for the floor and missing wall.
Rebuild the west wall and patch the floor and north opening.
steps.note: West wall, south corner, north wall opening and roof hole patched.

steps.text: Craft and place a chest and interior torches.
steps.note: Birch chest opens, two torches are lit, and the oak door shuts.
